offering_description.value: Operates a mobile social network app for gay, bi, trans and queer people to connect, chat and meet. It earns money from premium subscriptions and in-app advertising, delivered through iOS and Android app stores.

primary_products.value: mobile social networking app; premium subscription tiers; in-app purchases

customer_segment.value: B2C: LGBTQ individual app users, free and paying subscribers; B2B: advertisers and ad networks buying in-app advertising

end_markets.value: social networking; online dating; LGBTQ community; digital advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: paid premium tiers with extra features, billed via app stores; advertising: in-app ads and sponsored placements sold to advertisers; transaction or usage fees: in-app purchases of consumable features and boosts
revenue_model.category: subscription; advertising; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and runs its own social app platform, sold to consumers and advertisers

geography_served.value: global: Users in almost every country, with large markets in the US, Europe and Latin America

specialization.value: niche specialist: single LGBTQ social app with subscription and advertising monetization

distribution_channels.value: online: Apple App Store and Google Play app downloads; direct sales: advertising sales to brands and ad partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Data privacy rules such as GDPR, CCPA and FTC enforcement, app store policies, online safety and age-verification laws
